notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Mesa County Fair, 970-256-1528, Stacy Pennit / Kyle Carstens, and Taylor McCoy; Taylor left a message May 11, 2026. The sheet says CALL AFTER NEW YEAR FOR 2027. Preserve that future instruction without inventing a due date. Source: handwritten call notes, page 83.
